authority: spec/01_SEWCP-200_Cooling_Plate.md Rev A (FROZEN) - CP-D05, CP-D06, CP-D07, CP-D08, section 2.1, section 3.1 (keep-out table incl. the ECR-D-007 locator row), section 6, CP-IF-10

implementation/01_SEWCP-200_Cooling_Plate/cad/SEWCP-200_MDR-001_Coolant_Channel_Routing_Topology.md - ruled topology: concentric bifilar counterflow arc serpentine; pass schedule left as a checkable derivation

scope.bounded: The coolant channel (S3 + pocket), the two-piece split at the faying plane, and the FSW lid body CP_LID. Continues the existing saved document; the base solid, S1/S2 and PL_TOP from SEWCP-200-REQ-001 are prerequisites.
scope.deferred: Port pockets CP-D25 (local deepening to 10.00 with the 15 mm ramp), stub bores CP-D22/D23/D24, and the body+lid combine (feature strategy row 26) belong to the stubs package - they realise CP-IF-10 fully and are modelled with it. The channel terminals stop at centreline r=120 on the port azimuths so the pockets attach coaxially.
scope.modelling_note: S3 is modelled on PL_FAY (XY offset ch_z_btm), not on XY as the Rev X1 sketch plan table shows: the pocket cut then extrudes ch_depth upward from the faying plane, which is the geometry spec/01 section 6 step 3 describes. Equivalent geometry; to be captured in the OI-P-03 Rev X2 re-issue.
scope.rib_design_value: Rib between adjacent walls is 5.0 mm - the MDR-001 section 4 illustrative figure. No frozen artifact constrains it; whether FSW tool shoulder engagement demands a larger minimum is ECR-Q-011, raised per MDR-001 section 5 rather than assumed.

requirements.statement: Serpentine coolant channel, 10.00 W x 6.00 D (CP-D05 x CP-D06), milled into the body from the faying plane; wall confined to the O60-O250 annulus and clear of every section 3.1 keep-out row including the ECR-D-007 locator row; R5 minimum centreline bend; topology per MDR-001: concentric bifilar counterflow arc serpentine, pass schedule derived against the table, terminals at the CP-IF-10 port azimuths.
requirements.verification: G-19 envelope, G-20 keep-out table, M-07 min wall - computed from the observed sketch

requirements.statement: The FSW lid/body faying plane lies at z = 6.00 (ch_z_btm; equal to lid_thk by the lid_check identity). A named construction plane locates the channel sketch and the future weld documentation, so the joint height moves with the parameter stack.
requirements.source: spec/01 CP-D08, section 6 steps 3-5; ECR-D-002 Z stack
requirements.verification: Plane present at ch_z_btm above Datum A

requirements.statement: Two-piece construction: the lid volume (full O320 disc, z 0 to lid_thk) is removed from CP_BODY so the body is the machined 14 mm piece with the channel groove opening at its underside, exactly as manufactured before welding.

FSW lid, 6.00 mm thick, matching the body profile (O320), as a separate body CP_LID occupying z 0 to 6.00. Welded at step 5 with circumferential plus internal rib passes; the combine that represents the welded assembly is feature-strategy row 26, deferred with the stubs.

Radial temperature uniformity of the top face <= 1.5 degC across O280 at 3 kW. The section 2.1 design basis quotes ~2.2 m developed path; the derived schedule's length is reported by the router and any material shortfall is an engineering observation for the owner, not silently absorbed.
requirements.verification: Thermal map (hardware); path length reported at solution level

requirements.statement: 4.0 L/min at dP < 1.5 bar. NOT re-derived after ECR-D-002 and shall be verified on a flow bench before build release - restated here so no package appears to close it.
Proof pressure 6 bar / 30 min after welding, before finish machining. The channel geometry this package cuts is the pressure boundary interior.

Internal FSW rib passes weld the lid to the ribs between channel passes. The 5.0 mm design rib is not backed by a stated tool-shoulder minimum; ECR-Q-011 asks for one, and the routing is revisited if the answer exceeds 5.0.
requirements.source: spec/01 section 6 step 5; MDR-001 section 5; ECR-Q-011

requirements.statement: The channel interior is masked from hard anodize (step 13). Anodize in the coolant circuit is friable in flow and defeats the bare-aluminium wetted surface the design basis assumes.

interfaces.nature: Fluid - partially realised: channel terminals at the 255/285 port azimuths; stub bores and port pockets deferred to the stubs package

manufacturing.statement: Two-piece 6061-T651, friction stir welded at the z=6.00 faying plane; circumferential pass at or outboard of the O306 bolt circle (ECR-D-007 action 5); no elastomer in the pressure boundary.
